title: Clumsies Business API
description: Successful 2xx/3xx handler responses; excludes body transfer. Legacy route-only histograms appear separately as mixed results, never as success latency. All estimates use rolling 5-minute buckets; read the sample count. Missing collection is unknown, idle traffic has no latency sample.

panels.title: Requests observed · 5m
panels.description: Extrapolated window count, not an exact log count. Few requests make high percentiles unstable. Classified successful and failed distributions have their own sample counts; legacy mixed samples remain separate.

panels.title: Handler latency · 5m
panels.description: Successful 2xx/3xx handler responses; excludes body transfer. Legacy route-only histograms appear separately as mixed results, never as success latency. All estimates use rolling 5-minute buckets; read the sample count. Missing collection is unknown, idle traffic has no latency sample.

links.title: Inspect requests in this time range

panels.title: Requests over 1s by route · 5m
panels.description: 1s is an investigation filter, not a latency SLO.

panels.title: 5xx ratio and failed responses · 5m
panels.description: Read response sample count and status distribution beside this ratio. Existing <1% objective applies at the entrance; route breakdown locates the cause. New schema counts every actual 5xx class; legacy fallback counts the existing exact-status whitelist and may classify other codes as other.

targets.expr: (((sum(rate(clumsies_http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="server",route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health",route=~"$route",method=~"$method",status_class="5xx"}[5m])) or 0 * sum(rate(clumsies_http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="server",route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health",route=~"$route",method=~"$method",status_class!=""}[5m]))) / (sum(rate(clumsies_http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="server",route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health",route=~"$route",method=~"$method",status_class!=""}[5m])) > 0) * 100) or (((sum(rate(clumsies_http_requests_total{job="server",route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health",route=~"$route",method=~"$method",status=~"5.."}[5m])) or 0 * sum(rate(clumsies_http_requests_total{job="server",route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health",route=~"$route",method=~"$method"}[5m]))) / (sum(rate(clumsies_http_requests_total{job="server",route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health",route=~"$route",method=~"$method"}[5m])) > 0) * 100) unless on() sum(rate(clumsies_http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="server",route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health",route=~"$route",method=~"$method",status_class!=""}[5m])))) and on() (min(up{job="server"}) == 1)

panels.title: 5xx responses · 5m
panels.description: Read response sample count and status distribution beside this ratio. Existing <1% objective applies at the entrance; route breakdown locates the cause. New schema counts every actual 5xx class; legacy fallback counts the existing exact-status whitelist and may classify other codes as other.

targets.expr: (((sum(increase(clumsies_http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="server",route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health",route=~"$route",method=~"$method",status_class="5xx"}[5m])) or 0 * sum(increase(clumsies_http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="server",route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health",route=~"$route",method=~"$method",status_class!=""}[5m])))) or (((sum(increase(clumsies_http_requests_total{job="server",route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health",route=~"$route",method=~"$method",status=~"5.."}[5m])) or 0 * sum(increase(clumsies_http_requests_total{job="server",route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health",route=~"$route",method=~"$method"}[5m])))) unless on() sum(increase(clumsies_http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="server",route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health",route=~"$route",method=~"$method",status_class!=""}[5m])))) and on() (min(up{job="server"}) == 1)

panels.title: Business request lifecycle / second
panels.description: Business scope excludes health/metrics and respects route/method. response and cancelled_or_aborted are distinct. Absent data may be unsupported telemetry or no observed samples; do not fill it with zero.

panels.title: Failed handler latency · 5m
panels.description: Requires classified new-schema samples. Fast failures are not an improvement in success latency. No old mixed-result fallback is labeled as failure latency.

panels.title: Slow backend requests > 1s
panels.description: Expand a log line and open Related request logs to correlate the same request at the entrance and backend.

targets.expr: {service="server"} | json method="span.method", route="span.route", duration_ms="fields.duration_ms", message="fields.message", request_id="span.request_id", status="fields.status" | message="http request completed" | route!~"/metrics|/api/v1/admin/health" | route=~"${route:regex}" | method=~"${method:regex}" | duration_ms > 1000 | __error__="" | line_format "{{.route}} · {{.duration_ms}} ms · HTTP {{.status}} · request_id={{.request_id}}"

panels.title: Request correlation · enter a request ID
panels.description: An internal request_id links entrance and backend. A client ID first matches Server client_request_id; use that record's internal ID to find the entrance. Empty IDs, missing placeholders and prefixes return no logs. Ignores route/method/site; static requests naturally have no backend record.

targets.expr: {service=~"caddy|server"} |= ${request_id:doublequote} | json edge_request_id="request_id", server_request_id="span.request_id", client_request_id="span.client_request_id" | __error__="" | (edge_request_id!="" and edge_request_id!="missing" and edge_request_id=${request_id:doublequote}) or (server_request_id!="" and server_request_id!="missing" and server_request_id=${request_id:doublequote}) or (client_request_id!="" and client_request_id!="missing" and client_request_id=${request_id:doublequote})

options.content:
[App entrance slow requests](/d/clumsies-web/view?from=${__from}&to=${__to}&var-site=app.clumsies.ai) · [Database and pool](/d/clumsies-infrastructure/view?from=${__from}&to=${__to})

Method-specific metrics need the new Server schema. Old histograms are shown only as mixed results.

Paste a request ID above to correlate logs; empty ID returns no logs.

Product activity is the collapsed section at the bottom. Its snapshots do not measure request throughput or synchronization latency.

panels.title: Product snapshot health
panels.description: These are database row snapshots, not request throughput or synchronization latency. Current evidence requires host and database collection ages from 0 to 900 seconds. Future timestamps are invalid; recorded values remain unchanged.

targets.expr: ((clumsies_database_collection_success and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900))) or on(job,instance) ((0 * clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds - 2) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 0)) or on(job,instance) ((0 * clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds - 2) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 0)) or on(job,instance) (0 * up{job="node"} - 1)) or on() vector(-1)
targets.legendFormat: DB snapshot: 1 success / 0 failed / -1 stale missing / -2 invalid time

panels.title: Product snapshot age
panels.description: These are database row snapshots, not request throughput or synchronization latency. Negative age is invalid, never clamped to zero.

targets.expr: (((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) / 1) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900))) or on(job,instance) ((0 * clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds - 2) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 0)) or on(job,instance) ((0 * clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds - 2) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 0))

panels.title: Commits created in the last hour
panels.description: Sampled every 5 minutes: retained rows created in the last 60 minutes. Deletions reduce the count. This is neither a lifetime event counter nor synchronization latency. Includes bootstrap and system commits. Valid only after a successful snapshot no older than 15 minutes; see collection health below.

targets.expr: (clumsies_commits_created_last_hour) and on(job,instance) ((clumsies_database_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)))

panels.title: Drafts created in the last hour
panels.description: Sampled every 5 minutes: retained rows created in the last 60 minutes. Deletions reduce the count. This is neither a lifetime event counter nor synchronization latency. Valid only after a successful snapshot no older than 15 minutes; see collection health below.

targets.expr: (clumsies_drafts_created_last_hour) and on(job,instance) ((clumsies_database_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)))

panels.title: Reviews created in the last hour
panels.description: Sampled every 5 minutes: retained rows created in the last 60 minutes. Deletions reduce the count. This is neither a lifetime event counter nor synchronization latency. Valid only after a successful snapshot no older than 15 minutes; see collection health below.

targets.expr: (clumsies_reviews_created_last_hour) and on(job,instance) ((clumsies_database_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)))

panels.title: Drafts by lifecycle state
panels.description: Includes open, submitted, merged and discarded. Merged/discarded are historical states; open Drafts can remain in active use. Counts do not imply a service backlog. Valid only after a successful snapshot no older than 15 minutes; see collection health below.

targets.expr: (clumsies_drafts) and on(job,instance) ((clumsies_database_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)))

panels.title: Open Draft net change per hour
panels.description: Hourly slope of the last 6 hours of stored open Draft counts. Includes creation, reopening, submission, discard and deletion; not creation throughput or processing latency. Valid only after a successful snapshot no older than 15 minutes; see collection health below.

targets.expr: (deriv(clumsies_drafts{status="open"}[6h]) * 3600) and on(job,instance) ((clumsies_database_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)))

panels.title: Drafts with current reconciliation conflicts
panels.description: Open/submitted Drafts with a non-invalidated conflicting candidate matching the current Draft version, base commit and main ref. Historical candidates are excluded. Unevaluated Drafts are not counted; zero does not prove every Draft is conflict-free. Valid only after a successful snapshot no older than 15 minutes; see collection health below.

targets.expr: (clumsies_drafts_with_reconciliation_conflicts) and on(job,instance) ((clumsies_database_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)))

panels.title: Stored unread notification records
panels.description: Stored receipts with read_version below version, including archived or inaccessible notifications. Not the visible inbox badge or a notification delivery failure. Valid only after a successful snapshot no older than 15 minutes; see collection health below.

targets.expr: (clumsies_inbox_unread_records) and on(job,instance) ((clumsies_database_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)))

panels.title: Oldest open Draft age since creation (days)
panels.description: Time since created_at; recent edits do not reset this age. Zero when no open Draft exists. Not inactivity, synchronization latency or a processing deadline. Valid only after a successful snapshot no older than 15 minutes; see collection health below.

targets.expr: ((clumsies_oldest_open_draft_age_seconds / 86400) and on(job,instance) ((clumsies_database_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900))) and on(job,instance) (clumsies_oldest_open_draft_age_seconds >= 0)) or on(job,instance) (((0 * clumsies_oldest_open_draft_age_seconds - 2) and on(job,instance) (clumsies_oldest_open_draft_age_seconds < 0)) and on(job,instance) ((clumsies_database_collection_success == 1) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_database_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900)) and on(job,instance) (((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - clumsies_observability_collection_timestamp_seconds) <= 900))))
